name: Windows Defender
tagline: Free, built-in, and genuinely competitive — the honest first choice for most Windows 11 users
highlights: Free and already installed — zero setup, updates automatically with Windows Update
AV-TEST consistently awards 6/6 on protection, performance, and usability
No additional third party with deep system access — Microsoft telemetry already present
verdict: The correct first answer for most Windows 11 users. If you keep your system updated and practice basic security hygiene, you may not need anything else.
bestFor: Technically competent Windows 11 users who keep their systems updated and want zero additional cost or trust relationships

name: ESET
tagline: Lightest on system resources, Slovak company outside 5 Eyes — for users who want third-party verification
highlights: Consistently tops AV-TEST performance benchmarks — lowest system impact of any full antivirus suite
Slovak company: EU member, outside 5 Eyes and 9 Eyes intelligence alliances
Clean, upsell-free interface focused on doing the core job rather than bundling extras
verdict: The best paid option — tied with Defender on score, but with independent third-party verification and lighter system footprint. The right choice for users on older hardware.
bestFor: Users on older or lower-powered hardware, privacy-conscious users who want a non-US company, and technical users who want clean software without aggressive upselling

name: Bitdefender
tagline: Consistently maximum AV-TEST scores with minimal system impact — best detection rate in the category
highlights: AV-TEST consistently 18/18 across protection, performance, and usability — the maximum possible
Romanian company: outside US/UK intelligence sharing arrangements
No known incidents of data selling or inappropriate data collection
verdict: Best detection rate in the category. If maximum AV-TEST scores with minimal system impact is the priority, Bitdefender is the pick.
bestFor: Users who want the highest independent detection scores available and a Romanian-company alternative to US-based products

name: Malwarebytes
tagline: The best malware removal tool — best used alongside Windows Defender, not as a replacement
highlights: Exceptional at removing existing infections — finds adware and PUPs that traditional AV misses
Free version provides unlimited on-demand scanning with no time limit
Best used alongside Windows Defender: Defender for real-time protection, Malwarebytes for cleanup
verdict: Best for removing existing infections. Run the free version periodically as a second-opinion scanner alongside Windows Defender rather than as a replacement.
bestFor: Users who want a free second-opinion scanner to complement Windows Defender, or who need to remove an existing infection

name: Norton 360
tagline: Good detection, lots of bundled features — but the privacy history is disqualifying
highlights: Norton Crypto (2022): enrolled users in Ethereum mining using their computers without clear consent
Higher system impact than Bitdefender or ESET — noticeable slowdown on older hardware
Bundles VPN, password manager, and dark web monitoring — value depends on whether you need all three
verdict: Skip. The Norton Crypto incident is disqualifying for a product asking for deep system access. ESET and Bitdefender are better at every price point.
bestFor: Users who specifically want a single subscription covering antivirus, VPN, password manager, and dark web monitoring and are comfortable with Gen Digital's data practices
